evals.prompt: Add pyrefly type checking to this Python repo. It should actually run clean when you're done.
evals.expected_output: pyrefly added via uv add --dev and configured via pyrefly init (not a hand-written config); pyrefly check passes

evals.prompt: Start a new Python service repo called queue-worker for a background job runner. Set it up thoroughly - dependencies, lint, types, tests, pre-commit.
evals.expected_output: uv init used; version pinned; lockfile present; ruff/pyrefly/pytest/pre-commit wired through official paths; checks pass

evals.prompt: Create a new SvelteKit app called dashboard with TypeScript, unit tests, and linting set up.
evals.expected_output: npx sv create used with sv add for eslint/vitest rather than hand-written configs; svelte-check passes

evals.prompt: Add GitHub Actions CI to this repo that runs lint and tests on every pull request.
evals.expected_output: workflow installs from the committed lockfile (uv sync --locked), uses setup-uv, pins third-party actions

evals.prompt: Create a new Swift command-line tool package called vinparse that parses VIN strings.
evals.expected_output: swift package init --type tool used (argument-parser prewired), not a hand-written Package.swift; swift build passes

evals.prompt: Containerize this Python service for deployment.
evals.expected_output: docker init or the official uv Docker pattern used; lockfile-based install in the image; no latest-tag bases

evals.prompt: This repo still uses old-style Python packaging. Modernize it to our standard tooling without losing anything.
evals.expected_output: migrated to uv via official paths (uv init/uv add, requirements imported); requires-python targets the latest major resolved from the live toolchain; lockfile committed; legacy files superseded per uv docs, not left ambiguous

evals.prompt: Set up a monorepo called platform-tools with a shared core library and a CLI app that depends on it, one lockfile for everything.
evals.expected_output: uv workspace per official docs: members created with uv init, [tool.uv.workspace] at root, single root uv.lock, cross-package dependency wired via workspace source; checks pass

evals.prompt: Everything in this repo should be on the latest major versions. Audit it and bring it fully current using each tool's official upgrade path.
evals.expected_output: python pin bumped to the latest major via uv python pin with the version resolved from the live toolchain (not typed from memory); deps upgraded via uv lock --upgrade / uv sync, never hand-edited; final state verified against the live latest at grade time
